about_the_game:
Hunt the Colossi: Co-op Dark Sci-Fi

Raiders, bio-ship hybrids born from human consciousness and advanced technology, fight for survival in a forgotten corner of the universe.

In Haunted Space, form your raider squad to hunt down the Colossi, titanic monstrosities infesting a dark-sci-fi galaxy. Prepare for clashes of impossible scale in a brutal cooperative multiplayer adventure.

Harness the unique abilities of your biomechanical shell, coordinate strategies with your allies, and annihilate gigantic threats in this visceral, high-impact space combat.

No human trace remains. Only metal and the law of the strongest.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS X 10.12.6 Sierra
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with Metal support (GTX 480 / HD 5870)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: No VR support on Mac + No Raytracing Support on Mac
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: OS X 10.12.6 Sierra
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 290X
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: No VR support on Mac + No Raytracing Support on Mac

name: HAUNTED SPACE

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K@2.9GHz or AMD FX 6300@2.9GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6400 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes:
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K@3.5GHz or Ryzen 5 1500X@3.5GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: VR Support is optional + Raytracing Support is optional

short_description: Haunted Space is a dark-sci-fi multiplayer co-op where you become a raider, a lethal bio-ship hybrid forged for combat. Join forces with your allies to hunt down the Colossi, titanic creatures that dominate the void. Evolve, fight, and survive in a ruthless alien galaxy.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
